goals: Verify successful user login via the /users/connection endpoint with valid credentials.
activities: Define username 'Ranni'.
Define user email 'ranni@mail.fr'.
Define user password '123'.
Define user token '6lHCyi-6Vg8QDMhR3ZXBKlQNU070hQvS'.
Hash the user password.
Create a user in the database with the defined email, hashed password, token, and username.
Send a POST request to '/users/connection' with email 'ranni@mail.fr' and password '123'.
Assert that the response status code is 200.
Assert that the response body 'result' is true.
Assert that the response body 'token' matches '6lHCyi-6Vg8QDMhR3ZXBKlQNU070hQvS'.
Assert that the response body 'username' matches 'Ranni'.
